LESSON: PROHIBITIONS IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.3: Prohibitions in Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prohibitions in Islam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What causes deviant sexual behaviour in the society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the causes of deviant sexual behaviour to safeguard oneself
2. describe the effects of deviant sexual behaviour in the society
3. explain the rationale for the prohibition of deviant sexual behaviour in Islam
4. appreciate the rationale for the prohibition of deviant sexual behaviour

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
